CLOCKWISE.description: A rotary component type rotating in a clockwise fashion using the           right-hand rule.

COUNTER_CLOCKWISE.description: A rotary component type rotating in a counter clockwise fashion using           the right-hand rule.

NEGATIVE.description: A linear type component is moving in the direction of decreasing           position value.

POSITIVE.description: A linear type component is moving in the direction of increasing           position value.
